result.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.

AI.brief_summary: 在扩散 transformer 上用一组与输入无关的固定激活引导向量拟合 RL 微调后的速度预测，发现在 SD3.5-M 及两个视频模型上可复现大部分 RL 奖励增益，据此认为策略梯度后训练主要是把预训练生成器「导向」它已有的计算能力，而非学习新的输入相关变换。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以常数 steering 探针区分输入无关偏移与输入相关变换」的做法，可能可供核查 VLM 中 RL/latent 推理训练的收益究竟来自新计算还是内部状态偏移；但论文对象是图像与视频生成，与视觉推理主线并无直接交集，需较多核查。
